questions.stem: What does the law of reflection state?

options.text: The angle of incidence is always 90 degrees
The angle of incidence equals the angle of reflection
The angle of incidence is twice the angle of reflection
The angle of reflection depends on the material of the surface

questions.explanation: The law of reflection states that the angle of incidence equals the angle of reflection. Both angles are measured from the normal (the line perpendicular to the surface at the point of incidence).

questions.stem: From which line are the angles of incidence and reflection measured?
questions.explanation: Both the angle of incidence and the angle of reflection are always measured from the normal, which is the imaginary line drawn perpendicular to the surface at the point where the ray hits. A common mistake is to measure from the surface itself.
